requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 每 1 秒切换一次两个 LED 的状态，两个 LED 分别连接在 D12 和 D13 引脚。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Provide io_2 deltas in sequence [0,1000,1000,1000] with no other changes.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: At start (after first control step with io_2=0) io_0=false and io_1=false; after each additional 1000ms step both io_0 and io_1 toggle value each time: (true,true) then (false,false) then (true,true).
